coordinates: glTF meters; Y up; +Z forward. Blender native Z up, -Y forward.
mechanism: 5 real moving rigid node groups, each with one closed relative Melt morph; no bones, no skin, no runtime mesh generation.
node_scope: Resolve names within this asset root; glTF clip bindings use node indices, never scene-global shared names.
rest: Complete explicit translation/rotation/scale on every GLB node. Animation channels are absolute local transforms, not additive recipes. Reset all five groups + all five shape weights before changing clips; one active action at a time.

materials.vertex_colors: WaxColor is scene-linear converted from authored sRGB palette. glTF COLOR_0 is linear, no extra sRGB conversion by runtime.

Idle.behavior: Low-amplitude service balance; no breathing or organic acting

Walk_InPlace.behavior: Short plump drive legs translate: planted soles retreat at controller speed, swing soles clear the floor; arms counterbalance. Root stays fixed. Apply world controller separately.

Attack_Shove.behavior: Two tool arms shove forward, chassis anticipates and recovers

Hit.behavior: Damped chassis kick, mechanical service reaction

Melt.weights: All five GLB mesh morph target 0 / targetNames Melt: 0 -> 1 over 1.1 s. These are morph weights, NOT joints or bones.
Melt.behavior: Continuous closed wax housing flows wider and lower with unchanged topology; retained metal components tip into the pool. Feet stay above ground. No whole-object scale collapse.

controller_material_dim.note: Multiply the imported glTF emissiveFactor by the relative intensity multiplier; do not multiply by the native 0.45 twice. Convert sRGB baseColor to linear before shader assignment. Keep alpha=1 and opaque. This material operation is intentionally explicit controller work, not a claimed glTF material animation extension.

Melt.lod_contract: hi, lo, far and shadow each carry the actual same-named closed Melt target and complete 1.1 s clip. No mesh swap, no high-only promise.

socket_semantics: Shove sockets mark the tool contact envelope, slightly ahead/below the rigid palm; they are not vertices. Shove/Lamp anchors follow rigid nodes but not Melt vertex morphs: disable functional socket use immediately on Melt, keep Ground as controller anchor.
ground: Neutral lowest sole vertex Z=.003 in Blender / Y=.003 glTF; ground plane at 0. No renderer stage is exported.
crush: No optional Crush fragments supplied; these two assets are the entire catalog.
technical_cost: 5 mesh nodes, normally 6 draw primitives (Body work+lamp), 2 material classes. No full-game performance assertion.
bounds_note: Melt bounds must be measured from posed vertices (base + weight * relative delta), not a conservative static Three.js Box3 union of neutral/morph ranges.
